policy_notes: Missing canine normal heart/brain/lung DLA coverage is explicitly missing and never emitted as an experimentally validated empty blacklist.
Bulk digest proteomics (Pfizer, Labrador PeptideAtlas) can support protein existence and detectability controls, never DLA presentation.
Nested peptide windows, I/L inference, binding predictions, competition assays, tumors, cell lines, unresolved pools and human HLA data cannot satisfy this rule.

source_audit_ledger.reason: Direct DLA-DR ligand elution from two homozygous donor spleens; spleen cannot satisfy the heart/brain/lung requirement and the public supplement omits observed MS peptide sequences.
Ten-allele DLA-88 atlas in engineered canine melanoma-derived cell populations; normal-tissue expression comparisons are not experimental normal-organ DLA presentation.
Already curated primary canine tumors (4 dogs) and DLA-transduced human HCT116 cell lines; excluded from nonmalignant heart/brain/lung coverage.

source_audit_ledger.citation: Barth et al. 2016 (10.1371/journal.pone.0167017), Ross et al. 2018 (PMC5850932), Nemec et al. 2018 (PMID 30239163)
source_audit_ledger.reason: Allele and motif discovery in engineered cell lines rather than independently sampled nonmalignant heart, brain or lung.
MS ligand discovery is in an engineered histiocytic-sarcoma cell line; normal-tissue comparisons use RT-PCR rather than DLA elution.

miyamae_2026_dla88.title: Miyamae 2026 ten-allele canine DLA-88 ligand atlas
limitations: bioRxiv API reports license=cc_no; do not bundle or redistribute preprint tables in Hitlist.
Preprint full methods, residual endogenous MHC, FDR/confidence, searched reference and raw deposit accession remain unverified as of 2026-11-25.
Normal-tissue source-protein expression comparisons are not experimental normal-organ DLA presentation and cannot satisfy #674.
Do not extrapolate the ten measured DLA-88 alleles to predicted motif neighbours or treat cultures as independent normal dogs.

lang_2026_splenic_dla_dr.title: Lang 2026 splenic DLA-DR MS immunopeptidomics
lang_2026_splenic_dla_dr.citation: Lang et al., Journal of Immunology 2026, 215(9):vkag243

content_inventory.item: Motif R-script PDF and Supplementary Figure 1

limitations: Reviewed vkag243_supplementary_data.zip (1,866,144 bytes) supplies no observed MS peptide sequences.
Donor health status, treatment history, DRA chain typing, raw run IDs and searched FASTA remain unknown until full methods and MS exports are acquired.
Spleen cannot satisfy #674's heart/brain/lung vital-organ coverage rule even though two individual homozygous donors exist.
Rabies competition assays, motif predictions (Tables S3/S4) and source-protein count summaries (Tables S5/S6) are kept outside naturally presented MS observations.

canine_bulk_proteomics.title: Canine normal-tissue bulk MS (Pfizer & Labrador PeptideAtlas)
limitations: Pfizer (MSV000099744 / PXD070290) measures tryptic TMT tissue pools of six dogs; a positive pool cannot be expanded into six individual dogs.

Labrador PeptideAtlas (PXD052932) tissue donors are a stillborn female and a 6-month-old male euthanized for hip dysplasia; developmental/health context must be retained and DIA spectral libraries (PXD052902, SAL00328-SAL00330) stay separate from DDA tissue detections.
Bulk digest proteomics never becomes DLA immunoprecipitation or satisfies #674's presentation blacklist.
